scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs packages/*/tests/*.test.js apps/electron/tests/*.test.js apps/tauri/tests/*.test.js && npm run test:components -w @ineed-linklab/workbench

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ineed-linklab/electron && npm run build -w @ineed-linklab/tauri

scripts.package:mac:tauri: npm run package:mac:tauri:arm64 && npm run package:mac:tauri:x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:mac:electron && npm run package:mac:tauri && node scripts/collect-macos-dmgs.mjs

scripts.verify:phase-04: npm run verify:phase-03 && node tooling/tcp-test/localhost-loopback.mjs && git diff --check
